def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] == 5 for row in grid)]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)

    offsets = [1, 2]
    d = 4
    while d < min((r1-r0)//2 + 1, (c1-c0)//2 + 1):
        offsets.append(d)
        d += 2

    for i, d in enumerate(offsets):
        # First outline is 2; subsequent colors alternate in pairs.
        color = 2 if i == 0 or ((i - 1) // 2) % 2 == 1 else 5
        t, b = r0 + d, r1 - d
        l, r = c0 + d, c1 - d
        if t > b or l > r:
            continue
        for c in range(l, r + 1):
            out[t][c] = out[b][c] = color
        for rr in range(t, b + 1):
            out[rr][l] = out[rr][r] = color

    # Fill the remaining central cell or 2x2 area with the next color.
    t, b = r0 + d, r1 - d
    l, r = c0 + d, c1 - d
    if t <= b and l <= r and b-t <= 1 and r-l <= 1:
        color = 2 if len(offsets) % 2 == 1 else 5
        for rr in range(t, b + 1):
            for cc in range(l, r + 1):
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out

    while r0 + d <= r1 - d and c0 + d <= c1 - d:
        offsets.append(d)
        d += 2

    colors = [2, 5, 5]
    for i, d in enumerate(offsets):
        color = colors[i % len(colors)]
        top, bottom = r0 + d, r1 - d
        left, right = c0 + d, c1 - d
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bottom][c] = color

    left, right = c0 + d, c1 - d

        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
